Su Jinglei  is one of the main playable characters in Action Taimanin.

She is a Taimanin of the Chinese Union, who works for the PLA Intelligence Agency. Su came to Japan to be an adjutant to Fuuma Kotarou.


Personality
Su is a serious and stern person, being a bit of a tsundere. Her rather insulting and superior attitude with the Chinese Union, leads to minor conflicts for teams of other nations.

Having a rather black and white view of the Chinese Union and UFS, she clashed specially with Yukikaze, both ending up in rather childish angry rants. Su was also rather rude and dismissive to people like Kotaro. The only person she respected from the beginning was Igawa Asagi who she views as her "master".

However, her lack of flexibility and common touch changed over time, and she became more than a complaining stranger. Leaving her Chinese Union uniform behind, and now is able to talk with Yukikaze and her team with no problems. She worries about her parents at home quite a lot and is far softer than she lets on. When angered enough, begins to speak in her native tongue. Viewed even by her parents as a bit strict but is also loved just the same, and surprisingly caring.

Appearance
She is a young woman with red long hair, yellow eyes and an almost flat bust.

Wears large gauntlets and a black Taimanin suit with an open stomach area.


History
Background
Born, in the Chinese Union, as one of the rare people that had a Taimanin family line, Su's lineage came from her great-grandfather that became orphaned after the war and was taken in by China. Her parents seem to lack Taimanin abilities, but are very supportive.

She was a child prodigy and repeatedly skip grades and graduate at the top of her class, before graduating from Beidao University. Training in Japan under Asagi, she views her as her Master and Teacher. Being scouted as a lieutenant for a special company that prevent international terrorist attacks and the invasions from demons. She became a main player in the PLA Intelligence Agency as a soldier and investigator for them. Su has acquired great skills and fights to prevent international terrorism.

During her time at the PLA Intelligence Agency, she was also the mentor of Lan Xiang.

Timeline Action
Su came to Japan to be an adjutant to Fuuma Kotarou, helping in the investigation of Momochi Toyo. As a deputy officer of the Taimanin Task Force, she is the second in command should Fuuma not be able to act. During the first interactions, in which Su assisted to hunt down the Venam Liberation Armed Forces, which had a connection to Toyo, Su acted very unfriendly. Ideologically clashing with other members of the Task Force, for her strong overly patriotic, downright zealous statements about the Chinese Union and Japan's role to fall in line and demanding tone, with her command. As the Task Force G and Su, found the VLAF, the lead turned out cold, with the group murdered by Oboro Ninja Troops, though the Task Force was able to capture Oboro temporary.

Su continued to accompany the group, with the tension still present but trust beginning to form. On Kotrara Island of the Republic of Venam, the group in the end found Toyo, which got ready to spread CD Virus in the city to cause an interactional accident. As they defeated Toyo, it turned out to be a fake, and the CD virus was released regardless, another Toyo this time in demon form was defeated, but the damage was already done, and the mission was considered a failure.

After failing to stop Momochi's terror attack and only to reduce the damages, her standing in the Chinese Union has been weakened, and she decided to keep training in Gosha Academy to hone her ninja arts, helping Fuuma Kotaro and remaining in Fuuma Estate. Su would fully warm up to the group, interacting with their members on her own, though she has shown some concern for her family back home. Her family in the Chinese Union is mentioned later to be still in good health, celebrating their 20th wedding anniversary in Africa, with them reacting positive to Su's recent growth.

Su would, afterward, be a minor part of almost all story interactions but play a smaller part. Assisted in fights against, Astaroth, Death Wraith King and Edwin Black.

When, a Clone Yukikaze and Clone Murasaki, interfered with a VIP mission of Kannazuki Sora and Igawa Sakuya, blame came from the VIP, a pro Nomad politician against the Taimanin. While, Asagi and the Taimanin leadership could not act, and the real Yukikaze and Murasaki went into hiding, Su and other members of the Taimanin Task Force, went to the Chinese Union. Su used her old contacts in the PLA Intelligence Agency and reached out to Lan Xiang. While, Lan at first presented herself only a guard of the laboratory and pushed for tests as "payment" for the assistance, Lan became more aggressive overtime, frustrated that Su had still not returned from Japan and desired to return to it, once the mission was finished. Revealing, that she was the one overwatching the research lab, she challenged the other members of the Task Force but was overwhelmed by Su herself. Su, explaining that she now viewed herself as a member of the Task Force and convinced Lan afterward to assist. Learning that these clones, had certain genetic markers that made them clearly not made by a Chinese Union group but most likely Task Force G.

Powers/Abilities
Su Ultimate
Main Weapon: Gauntlets

Ninja Art: "Beast Art - Transformation Dragon", "Transformation" a beast art able to give Su the power of a Black Dragon. She can form energy wings, power up her eyes and use a charging mode to use Dragon Flame Swords from the breath of the dragon. This dragon takes the form of an aura of particles.
Flight: With her aura dragon wings.
Energy Blades: Blades of dragon energy
Defensive Aura: Short time from aura
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.
Media
Action Taimanin

Trivia
Su has many similarities to Yukikaze; tsundere of a smaller build with flat chests, think little of Fuuma at the beginning and have a sweet tooth, they react similarly and are drawn by Aoi. This didn't stop them from disliking each other at the beginning, as they started bickering rather quickly. Even though they became friends since.
Her height here is visually approximated from her model in Action Taimanin, compared to other models, with known character heights.
Su's Dragon costume form resembles Fate/Extra servant Elizabeth Bathory.
Black Dragons, as in her ability, also are mentioned in Witch of Steel Annerose, in which Mitico Fleuretty is a literal Black Dragon, that is transformed.
Possibly one cm taller than Aishu Hebiko. Her height here is visually approximated from her model in Action Taimanin, compared to other models, with known character heights.
Age presumed based on the blue tie Gosha costume.
